scenario: Newlines inside a regex literal are a lexer error per LREG.6.5. A regex pattern that spans a physical line break (an actual newline between `/` delimiters) is rejected at parse time. Patterns needing a newline character use `\n` escape instead.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /test
newline/
->
    log info "x"
